MoreBees standalone-Pi installer v2.0.0

  sudo bash installers/standalone/install_standalone.sh [flags]

Flags:
  --only <k[,k...]>    run only these phases, by number or name (allow-list,
                       wins over --skip-phase), e.g. --only camera
  --skip-phase <k>     skip a phase, by number or name (repeatable)
  --dry-run            print the plan and exit, changing nothing
  --verbose            stream command output instead of the spinner
  --non-interactive    never prompt; take defaults
  --help               this text

Phases (--only and --skip-phase take either column):
  10   pi_system    System Dependencies
  15   fonts        GUI Fonts
  20   daqhats      MCC DAQ HAT Library
  22   realtime     Real-Time Priority (opto engine)
  30   release      Release Checkout
  40   python_env   Python Environment
  50   desktop      Desktop Integration
  55   cli          CLI Wrappers
  60   data         Data Directory
  70   blue_green   Blue-Green Update Layout
  75   camera       Camera Recorder
  80   deploy_key   Deploy Key
  90   hardware     Hardware Setup

Env: RSO_GIT_REF=vX.Y.Z (release to install), RSO_ALLOW_REPROVISION=1
     (override the already-provisioned refusal), MB_VERBOSE=1, MB_UI=plain
